ops.title: linux-host CI fails at Install the host right after a dependency is published
ops.premise: Run 38089608616, job `linux-host` (114323167174), step "Install the host", on PR #352 at 21:58:15Z on 2026-10-10. The PR moved the pin to cc-transcript 14.40.0, which had reached PyPI at 21:55Z. Premise: the failure is a package-index propagation race on the fresh release, not the diff.
